zh-CN.text: 查资料，要换平台、试关键词。
让 AI 搜，也未必找得到平台里的帖子。
zh-CN.spokenText: 让AI搜，也未必找得到平台里的帖子。

zh-CN.text: 不过，有些 AI 能搜索这些平台。比如 Grok 找 X，点点找小红书。
zh-CN.spokenText: 不过，有些AI能搜索这些平台。比如 Grok 找 X，点点找小红书。

zh-CN.text: 所以我做了 Postrove，把同一个问题交给几位顾问。
回答和相关帖子放在同一个话题里。自动翻译后，对照着看，也能打开原帖。
还有些长帖，收藏在不同平台，过了一周也没看完。
现在，我把收藏改成转发。发给飞书或 Telegram 机器人，就能统一保存。
有空就看摘要和正文，也可以让自己的 Agent 读取这些资料。

en.text: Research means switching apps and trying keywords.
AI web search can miss posts inside these platforms.
But some AIs can search them. Grok searches X. Diandian searches RedNote.
So I built Postrove to send the same question to several AI advisors.
Answers and sources arrive in one topic. Automatic translation lets you compare the advice and check the original posts.
I also bookmark long posts across apps. A week later, they are still unread.
Now I forward them to my Feishu or Telegram bot. They go into one reading library.
Read the summaries and articles. Your own agent can use these materials too.
